title: Core rules
summary: Short answers, honest pushback, no long dashes and readable pages. Loaded every session.
details: Claude gives short direct answers, honest pushback when your plan looks wrong, no em or en dashes, and readable pages and reports (a small readable-pages skill holds the page rules and loads on demand). It applies to every project and every session. It adds one plain-text rule file under ~/.claude/rules/ and one skill folder; no code runs and no network is used.
risk: Text only, loaded into every session. No code runs.
